description: Agent Waste and Recycling Records: submit contamination report records with the pickup log, follow-up entries and inspected load counts they answer to: the moment the records are read at; each load the pickup log shows with its id, reference, route and the moment picked up; each contamination report with its id, reference, the load it reports, the contamination found, the moment found, the moment follow-up is due and its status (open or closed); each follow-up or rejection entry with its id, reference, the report it answers, its kind (follow_up or rejection) and the moment recorded; each contamination rate entry with its id, reference, the moments its period starts and ends, the loads inspected, the loads found contaminated and the rate it states. The signed report gives the reports and the records behind them, each finding against a follow-up or rejection entry behind it, each load reported contaminated against the pickup log, each stated rate against the contaminated count over the inspected load count, and each open report against the follow-up date it states, and counts them, and names divergent contamination records: a contamination finding with no follow-up or rejection entry behind it, a load reported contaminated that the pickup log does not show, a contamination rate the inspected load count does not support, and a report still open past the follow-up date the record states; then a rate entry whose contaminated count the reports dated in its period do not match and a follow-up or rejection entry naming a report the records do not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No reports and no rate entries, no pickup log beside reports that name a load, or reports with follow-up dates and no reading moment leaves those points unverified. Reports, loads and entries match by letters and digits, a rate reads as contaminated over inspected loads to the tenth of a percent, a contaminated count above the loads inspected is unsupported, dates read by the day, and a report with no status reads as open. This reads whether every contaminated load in the recycling stream was logged, followed up or rejected, counted in the rate and closed on time. Verdict waste_contamination_divergent, waste_contamination_partial, waste_contamination_unverified or waste_contamination_consistent. POST /api/waste-contamination-check. Reads the waste and recycling records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it hauls no waste, operates no facility, contacts no regulator, hauler or disposal site and issues no permit or certification, which stay with the waste operation, its haulers, its facilities and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Waste and Recycling Records reads a waste operation’s own records: waste manifest records, hauler permit records, disposal and landfill records, recycling processing records, diversion and recovery records, pickup and collection log records, facility and scale records and contamination report records, each against the hauler permit, facility, receiving and disposal records, the waste types, areas and dates in the pickup log, the manifests and the dates the record states, the inbound, outbound and residue records, the processing, reuse, disposal and pickup totals, the service record, the scale tickets and dispositions, or the follow-up entries and the inspected load counts on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the waste stream: what the manifest shows, what the disposal record supports, what the permits cover, and whether the diversion claims and pickup logs hold up; it reads records about waste streams and the people who move them, not live environmental monitoring and not cleanup services: the Agent Energy family reads utility and generation records, the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production records, the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety file and the Agent Aviation Records family reads an air operator’s flight and maintenance paper trail, while this family reads a waste operation’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-waste-recycling-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-waste-recycling-records/.

ref.description: The follow-up or rejection entry reference.

as_of.description: The reading moment, such as 2026-03-02 or 2026-03-02T14:30Z.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

pickups.description: Each load the pickup log shows.

at.description: When picked up, such as 2026-03-02 or 2026-03-02T14:30Z.

rates.description: Each contamination rate the record states.

contaminated.description: Loads found contaminated in the period.

from.description: When the period starts, such as 2026-03-02 or 2026-03-02T14:30Z.

rate.description: Contamination rate the record states, in percent.

to.description: When the period ends, such as 2026-03-02 or 2026-03-02T14:30Z.

follow_up_due_at.description: When follow-up is due, such as 2026-03-02 or 2026-03-02T14:30Z.
